privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires migrating a logbook containing 29 dives (found in SampleDivesV2.ssrf) to an SQLite file named 'dives.db' in /home/ga/Documents. Note: Subsurface typically uses XML (.ssrf/.xml) as its native format; the agent must attempt to use the 'Save As' dialog to change the format to SQLite as instructed. Although metadata might suggest 8 dives, the actual file contains 29 dives.
